title: Persol Career says 61万6,329件 doda records leaked after unauthorized access to contractor's TONARIWA
date_note: 26 November is the day of Persol Career's second report, per Cybersecurity.com (Japan); Dentsu Digital's own notice dated 12 November gave the first disclosure.
geo_basis: Japan, as the companies are Japanese; no city stated in the pages read
summary: Cybersecurity.com (Japan) reports that Persol Career's second report on 26 November confirmed the leak of 61万6,329件 (616,329) records connected to doda's LINE account, after unauthorized access to the TONARIWA platform run by contractor Dentsu Digital. The article lists name, birth date, gender, phone number, employer and employment status. Dentsu Digital's notice of 12 November says logs showed data taken from TONARIWA.
plain: Persol Career says 61万6,329件 (616,329) doda records leaked via its contractor Dentsu Digital's TONARIWA platform. Names, birth dates and phone numbers are among the data, the article says.
exec: Persol Career says 61万6,329件 (616,329) records leaked at a contractor; the article says it found no unauthorized access to its own systems.
action: As Persol Career says, affected customers will be contacted individually by email; the LINE official account is suspended, so contact advisers by phone or email.

validation.note: Dentsu Digital's own notice (12 November) states the unauthorized access to TONARIWA and data-taking logs; the 616,329 figure and Persol's second report come from Cybersecurity.com (Japan) only. Persol Career's own page returned 403.
